title: God Promises Abraham
summary: God Promises Abraham follows a real Bible moment about promise. God keeps promises even when they seem impossible to us. When waiting feels like nothing is happening, Abraham's night sky reminds you that God's promises do not get weaker with time.

read_it.prompt: Read Genesis 15:1-6 slowly and listen for the choice, promise, warning, or rescue in the story.

tell_it: God promised Abraham a family as many as the stars. In the story, Abram wondered how God's promise would happen. God showed him the stars and Abram believed the Lord.
understand_it: God keeps promises even when they seem impossible to us. God Promises Abraham also shows that promise has a shape in real life, not only in Bible vocabulary.
age_5_7_explanation: God promised Abraham a family as many as the stars.
age_8_11_explanation: Abram wondered how God's promise would happen. God showed him the stars and Abram believed the Lord. Ages 8-11 can name the Bible detail in God Promises Abraham and the takeaway: God keeps promises even when they seem impossible to us.
teen_explanation: God keeps promises even when they seem impossible to us. For teens, the lesson is worth discussing honestly because it connects belief with public choices, private motives, and costly obedience.
key_truths: God keeps promises even when they seem impossible to us.
God Promises Abraham shows promise through a real Bible moment, not a slogan.
When waiting feels like nothing is happening, Abraham's night sky reminds you that God's promises do not get weaker with time.
life_application: When waiting feels like nothing is happening, Abraham's night sky reminds you that God's promises do not get weaker with time.

activity.title: Stars of Promise
activity.instructions: Draw stars and write one promise from God that helps people wait with hope.

prayer_prompt: God, show me where God Promises Abraham touches my own life, and help me respond with honesty, courage, and obedience.
